Money20/20 Asia 2027 is in Bangkok and ETHSingapore has no 2027 edition; Singapore Blockchain Week failed TLS and is logged blocked.

Six Meetup groups read directly, eleven Luma host calendars pulled through their own items endpoint, and the AI Tinkerers Singapore chapter. Two Luma calendars (ClickHouse Events, SuperNerds Club) yielded one held Singapore edition each and are recorded as intermittent/occasional rather than padded.

Every open room's access text was rebuilt from its listing span with a whole-token midnight rule. Repaired: Pico Day (9:00-224:00 -> 09:00-20:00) and Masons Table (124:00-23:30 -> 10:00-23:30). One genuine overnight span remains and is labelled: The Offline Room prints Sat/Sun 08:00-02:00, i.e. a close at 02:00 the next morning. Three rooms have no published clock (NG Glass, NG Ngee Ann, Raffles City Bras Basah).

One Nominatim lookup each for 1 St Andrew's Road, 80 Bras Basah Road and 11 Eunos Road 8; every result carried the printed postal code. Six rooms (NG Glass, NG Ngee Ann, Raffles City Bras Basah, LLI x3) gain a derived point tied to their address claim. room2f keeps no point: the listing masks the address, and a pin without an address would look precise without being verifiable.

legacy-dispositions.json gives every 2026-q4 row a disposition with a reason and, where the 2026-11-24 enumeration surfaced it, the listing card as new evidence. A capacity below 50 in the 2026-08 evidence is recorded as a fact about that evidence, not as a closure.

Operator and marketplace galleries were checked first and never republished without a stated licence. Wikimedia Commons geosearch (150 m) plus file searches by building name cleared 30 assets across 17 records (1-3 each; none reached the four-photo target): CC BY-SA 4.0 x14, copyrighted free use x6, CC BY 4.0 x3, CC BY-SA 3.0 x3, CC BY-SA 2.0 x1, CC BY 2.5 x1, CC BY 3.0 x1, public domain x1. Every asset URL returned HTTP 200 image/jpeg at an allowed Wikimedia thumbnail size. Two earlier assets of the Resorts World Sentosa complex were withdrawn from the Genting Hotel Jurong lead and recorded under photos.json `withdrawn`: they show a different building about 12.4 km away, and one Commons file, File:Genting Hotel 10-11-2023.jpg, replaced them. The other 19 records (17 assessed rooms and 2 leads) carry an explicit withheld reason, including three Lifelong Learning Institute rooms whose building could not be matched.

The lead at 2 Town Hall Link is named from the RWS meetings card, but The Straits Times (2025-10-14 15:07 SGT) reports 'Four Points by Sheraton Singapore, Jurong will be at 2 Town Hall Link, and is a rebranding of the current Genting Hotel Jurong', opening early 2026 with 720 sqm of function space, and rwsentosa.com answered HTTP 403 to this run while its hotel page describes the property as temporarily suspended. No room is added or removed: the lead keeps its sourced capacity and the 2027 trading name is flagged for the page card.

stop_rule: Stopped at the cap of 30 assessed rooms once the platform, operator and hotel lanes had each produced their documented yield.
